responsibility: Implements analysis of polymorphic-call contexts used by devirtualization and IPA propagation. It reasons about whether types contain polymorphic subobjects, possible placement-new effects, and how an ipa_polymorphic_call_context can be restricted, merged, or generalized as it tracks outer type, offsets, derived/in-construction state, and speculation. This file focuses on context inference and lattice operations for virtual-call type information rather than on enumerating targets, which is handled in ipa-devirt.cc.
